name: Samudayik Sahbhagita
benefit: - SMC/SMDC are formed in all government schools to actively involve the community in education. - The scheme provides awards and certificates of appreciation to community members who demonstrate excellence in the field of education. - The Sapno Ki Udaan program promotes innovative and outstanding work in education to the public.
_eligibility_text: 1. The members of the local community shall be eligible under this scheme. 1. SMC/SMDC are formed in all government schools to actively involve the community in education. 1. The regular training programs for SMC/SMDC members are conducted by the DIET. 1. Under Samudayik Sahbhagita, outstanding and innovative work in the field of education is promoted through documentary films, banners, flexes, and radio broadcasts.
